# Helanka Vacations

> Custom Sri Lanka holiday packages designed by locals. Wildlife safaris, hill country trains, beach escapes, and MICE services.

Helanka Vacations is a licensed tour operator based in Rajagiriya, Colombo, Sri Lanka, operating under MendisOne Pvt Ltd. We design personalized travel experiences across Sri Lanka for international travelers.

## Services

- Custom holiday packages (3-21 days)
- Wildlife safaris (Yala, Udawalawe, Wilpattu, Minneriya)
- Hill country and tea estate tours
- Beach and coastal escapes
- Cultural and heritage tours
- MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Events)
- Group experiences (cricket tours, rugby tours, golf holidays)
- Honeymoon and special occasion packages
- Airport transfers and private transport

## Destinations We Cover

- Sigiriya (Lion's Rock, Cultural Triangle)
- Kandy (Temple of the Tooth, hill country)
- Ella (Nine Arch Bridge, tea plantations)
- Yala (leopard safaris, national park)
- Galle (Dutch Fort, southern coast)
- Mirissa (whale watching, beaches)
- Nuwara Eliya (tea country, cool climate)
- Dambulla (cave temples, golden temple)
- Trincomalee (east coast beaches, diving)
- Udawalawe (elephant safaris)
- Arugam Bay (surfing, east coast)
- Anuradhapura (ancient ruins, sacred city)
- Polonnaruwa (medieval capital)
- Adam's Peak (pilgrimage, sunrise trek)

## How It Works

1. Visit helanka.co and use Build Your Trip or contact us
2. Tell us your dates, interests, group size, and budget
3. A dedicated travel specialist designs your itinerary
4. Review your personalized quote with day-by-day details
5. Confirm with a 30% deposit via bank transfer
6. We handle all logistics: hotels, transport, guides, activities

## Pricing

- All prices quoted in USD
- Custom quotes based on accommodation tier, group size, season, and activities
- Packages typically range from $80-300+ per person per day depending on tier
- Payment via bank transfer (Sampath Bank) or secure payment links
